text_block_list.text:
One day I stopped by the department store 
basement, which was bustling with 
Valentine's Day chocolate sales.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should buy something for Air 
Shakur)

text_block_list.text:
She basically chooses what to eat purely 
from a nutritional standpoint. She rarely 
consumes treats or luxury foods, but...

She's often nibbling on glucose tablets, 
and sometimes I see her eating chocolate 
the same way. She seems to like crunchy 
things she can crunch down on.

Since there was such a wide variety 
available, I decided to buy some while 
keeping her preferences in mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur, found you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, I tried making friendship 
chocolates with my classmates. Please eat 
some later!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I didn't hear you ask, "Would you 
accept this?" though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I said, "Please eat them." I'll bring some 
to your room later!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ... Seriously, you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Bon appétit"? Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just a notice on the bathroom wall, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait, what does that mean!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...There's a trick where you say thank 
you first to make it harder for them to 
say no. What was it called, 
presupposition?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehh, then you're wrong! I'm not a poster!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because... I just wanted to tell you, 
'Thank you for letting me give it to you.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(――Seriously, I just don't get it. What 
kind of feeling is wanting to "give" 
without asking for anything in the first 
place?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Shakur! Care for some 
delicious chocolate? Complimentary, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's normal to want something in return 
like she does. At least that I can 
understand.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...Forget it. No point overthinking it. 
Guess I'll sort out the data for the Tenno 
Sho Spring.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Hey, Shakur-kun? I'm sure the 
sense-expanding chocolate would be a 
blast, though.

Air Shakur stared intently at the PC 
screen. It should be just about time for 
her to start craving some glucose, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nn...

I quickly prepared the chocolate I bought 
the other day. So as not to throw off her 
calculations, I chose one with the same 
nutritional value as her usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ooooh……

It's low on sweetness and quite hard—a 
masterwork of rich, high-cacao chocolate 
meant to be savored with every bite. I 
hope it provides some good stimulation...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For some reason... today's chocolate felt 
tastier than usual, I think.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Well, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, don't just look satisfied by yourself, 
tell me the brand. I'm asking you here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be, it was for Valentine's Day? 
...Knowing her, that's entirely possible.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them. Satisfied all on 
their own...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. How pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...No. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Today's chocolate tasted unusually good. 
I usually just eat it without thinking, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...Must be Valentine's. The wrappers were 
left lying around all sloppy.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If that's what you mean, just say it 
straight. Seriously, the way you do things 
is so gross.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because... I just wanted to tell you, 
'Thank you for letting me give it to you.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I still don't get what the hell you're 
on about. Stop getting so drunk on your 
own self-satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait until you see the actual results 
before you act so satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—I texted you yesterday, but... I'm 
changin' the menu.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
While running the numbers, I thought of a 
different approach. Looks like that one's 
more efficient.
choice_data_list: Glad I got that flash of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Beats me, but maybe it gave your brain 
some good stimulation.

She sounded oddly reluctant for some 
reason, but... It looks like we'll get 
some good training done today.
